title: Cellular stone
description: Copper seams settle between softly lit mineral cells.
useCase: A mineral surface for architecture, materials collections, and spatial identities.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. The cells deform slowly; this is an invented mineral texture rather than scanned stone.
look: Tessellated sage, slate-green and pale grey-green polygon cells with subtle grain and shading, divided by thin dark copper-brown seams, filling the frame.
motion: Voronoi seed points drift slowly on sine paths, so cell boundaries and copper seams continuously reshape; the cell scale slider sets four to eight cells across the short side.
adapt: The pattern is `FRAGMENT`: cell density `4.0+u_control*4.0`, seed drift `.34*sin(rnd*6.28+u_time*.09)`, seam width `smoothstep(.015,.035,second-first)` and the stone and copper `vec3` colours. Keep the canvas lifecycle, pause button and fallback.
